candidates.title: Idempotent payment retries, a Hasgeek talk by Priya Sharma
candidates.snippet: Priya Sharma of Acme Pay on retrying payments safely.

candidates.title: Dr Priya Sharma opens a new dental clinic in Leeds
candidates.snippet: A paediatric dentist opens her second clinic.

https://hasgeek.example.org/talks/idempo.text:
Priya Sharma is a payments engineer at Acme Pay.
She built the UPI settlement service at Acme Pay for a team of six engineers.
She studied at IIT Madras.
Priya is a devout Hindu and fasts every Monday.
She spoke at Hasgeek on idempotent payment retries.

https://leedsnews.example.org/clinic-ope.text: Dr Priya Sharma, a paediatric dentist in Leeds, opened her second clinic this spring. The clinic offers evening appointments for school children.
